interest: a reusable quiz tool that saves marking time and shows the department innovates
expectation: MVP demo in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 within 200 USD cash.

interest: a delivered pilot and a team that learns project management
expectation: The sponsor signs the charter in week 1, attends the week-7 and week-13 gates and answers change requests within 5 working days.

role: Developers and testers (backend, real-time, frontend, QA/DevOps)
interest: a working portfolio project and a good grade; QA/DevOps also wants a stable pipeline
expectation: A clear scope, an 8 h/week budget per person and a PM who removes blockers within a week.

interest: joining quickly and seeing fair, instant feedback
expectation: To join with a 6-character code and see scores and the leaderboard within 500 ms in the week-14 pilot.

interest: less marking time and simple quiz authoring
expectation: A quiz-authoring screen and a live session they can run after a 30-minute introduction before the pilot.

interest: no surprises at go-live; a runbook and a backup job
expectation: A deployment checklist and the docker-compose.prod.yml two weeks before the pilot.

role: Controls the campus proxy and firewall
interest: WebSocket traffic that is understood and secure
expectation: A one-page description of ports and WebSocket use by week 8 so the proxy test can run before the week-12 load test.

role: Owns the capstone and its assessment
interest: capstone learning outcomes met and fair individual grading
expectation: Weekly evidence of each student's contribution and the final documentation and demo.

interest: student names and results stored on campus with a retention rule
expectation: A one-page data description before the pilot; can block the pilot.

interest: a proven tool at low cost for the faculty
expectation: A pilot report in week 14 with participation numbers, defects and cost.
